counterexample: x(yz) = y(x(yz)), x(yz) = y(x(xz)), x(yz) = y(y(xz)) and x(yz) = (yx)(yz) have anchored models for every N <= 6 but no affine model for N > 1; x(yz) = y((yx)z) has a non-affine model at N = 2 (EXP-C06-04).
statement: For every law of EXP-C06-03 other than left-distributivity, the anchored spectrum for N <= 6 equals the set of N for which some affine table x*y = x + a*y + 1 satisfies the law.
title: H-C06-3: anchored spectra are affine spectra (refuted)
